name: cmm-language-support
shortDescription: Syntax highlighting, autocompletion and language intelligence for C-- (Cmm), GHC's native intermediate language.
description:
Full editor support for hand-written C-- (Cmm), the native intermediate representation of the Glasgow Haskell Compiler.

- Registers Cmm as a first-class VS Code language (`.cmm` plus the bundled Cmm macro headers).
- TextMate grammar covering sections, data declarations, procedures, labels, control flow, the `foreign "C"` FFI, primops (`%zx32`, `prim %sqrt64f`), pointer annotations (`"ptr"`) and the `%` modulo/primop ambiguity.
- Language server with contextual autocompletion (locals, globals, procedures, labels, primops, C symbols and every `stdc--.h` / `cmmath.h` macro, including the macro's expansion), hover documentation, signature help, diagnostics tailored to Cmm's real foot-guns, go-to-definition, references, document links, folding and an outline.
- One Run button that compiles the active file with `gmm` and runs the result, using the executable location you choose and the project's `conf.hmm` when it has one. Output goes to a terminal.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The language server only reads source files and headers; it does not run any code.

cmm.gmmPath.markdownDescription: Location of the `gmm` executable. Accepts a full path (`/opt/gmm/bin/gmm`, `C:\gmm\bin\gmm.exe`) or a bare command name resolved through `PATH`. Leave empty to search `PATH` and the usual install directories. Use **Cmm: Select gmm Executable…** to browse for it. Used by **Cmm: Run Cmm File**.

cmm.build.args.markdownDescription: Extra flags passed to `gmm` when running, split the way a shell would honouring quotes. For example `-keep-obj`, `-llvm`, `-rts`, `-libs pthread,m`, `-D DEBUG`, `-I ./include`. See `gmm -h` for the full list.

cmm.build.output.markdownDescription: Output binary name passed to `gmm -o` when running. Leave empty to use the `output=` from `conf.hmm` when the project has one, otherwise the name of the file being built.

cmm.includePaths.markdownDescription: Extra directories searched by the language server when resolving `#include "..."`, and when indexing the macros of Cmm headers such as `stdc--.h` and `cmmath.h`. `gmm` bundles these headers inside its own binary; pointing at the checkout (for example `gmm/libgmm`) gives the most accurate results.

enumDescriptions: Offer the bundled stdc--.h / cmmath.h / ret.h macros only when the document includes the corresponding header.
Always offer the bundled macros, even when the header is not included.
cmm.bundledStdlib.description: When the bundled Cmm macro libraries take part in autocompletion.

cmm.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Cmm language server.

cmm.diagnostics.undeclaredVariables.description: Report identifiers used in an expression that are neither declared, imported, defined in another workspace .cmm file, nor provided by an indexed header.

cmm.diagnostics.deadCode.description: Report statements that can never run because a `jump` (a non-returning tail call) precedes them in the same block.

cmm.diagnostics.returnInMain.description: Report `return (...)` as the final statement of `main`, which can segfault in hand-written Cmm. Prefer `foreign "C" exit(0);` or `mexit(0);`.

cmm.diagnostics.unknownPrimops.description: Report `%name` primitive operations that are not part of the known Cmm primop set.

cmm.diagnostics.arity.description: Report calls that pass a different number of arguments than a known non-variadic macro or procedure expects.

cmm.diagnostics.missingHeader.description: Report `#include "..."` directives whose header cannot be found in the workspace or in the configured include paths.

cmm.diagnostics.missingSemicolon.description: Report statements that are not terminated with `;`.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:grammar && npm run lint:diagnostics && npm run smoke && npm run test:protocol && npm run test:gmm && npm run test:load && npm run test:run
